guard: a successor never reaches broker retirement until the exact orphan runtime process is authoritatively gone
why: The suite starts a real manager and a detached real seat process, kills only the exact manager PID, then starts the logical successor.
The mutation bypasses the successor's runtime reap while retaining broker verified eviction, recreating the measured state where the old OS process survives.
The named real-process assertion must go red because the predecessor PID is still executing.

mutations.name: retire broker rails without reaping the orphan runtime
mutations.expectRed: successor reaps the exact orphan process before replacement admission
mutations.cell: successor reaps the exact orphan process before replacement admission
